title: Compiled program
statement: Given a light program $P$, a procedure index $p_0$, and a Boolean flag $d$, the compiled program is the concatenation of the header code, main code, procedure-body code, dispatcher, and start code, with each component determined by $P$, $p_0$, and $d$ as appropriate.
caveat: The component compiler constructions are not defined in the payload, so their detailed meanings cannot be stated.
